name: 3D Gaussian Splatting for CT
aliases: Sparse-view CT reconstruction with a 3D Gaussian representation
definition: A sparse-view CT reconstruction method that uses a 3D Gaussian representation as an alternative to implicit neural representations, utilizing FBP-image-guided initialization and a differentiable CT projector to recover precise CT values.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting for CT is a sparse-view reconstruction method using explicit 3D Gaussians and NeRF-style volumetric rendering to avoid spectral bias and recover precise physical CT values.
